consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: prohibition notice - work stopped during commissioning of replacement equipment on CV-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on CV-3100 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically selecting isolation points and devices. CV-3100 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 3 August 2019 a regulatory notice was issued concerning CV-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following commissioning of replacement equipment.
